segments.mn126:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.mn126:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā bhūmijo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena jayasenassa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.mn126:3.1: Atha kho jayaseno rājakumāro yenāyasmā bhūmijo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā bhūmijena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn126:3.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jayaseno rājakumāro āyasmantaṃ bhūmijaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn126:3.3: “santi, bho bhūmija, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino –
segments.mn126:3.4: ‘āsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā [carati, abhabbo (sī. pī.) evamuparipi ekavacaneneva dissati] phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:3.5: anāsañcepi [āsañca anāsañca cepi (aṭṭha.)] karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:3.6: āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:3.7: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāyā’ti.
segments.mn126:3.8: Idha bhoto bhūmijassa satthā kiṃvādī [kiṃvādī kiṃdiṭṭhī (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] kimakkhāyī”ti?
segments.mn126:4.1: “Na kho metaṃ, rājakumāra, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ.
segments.mn126:4.2: Ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.mn126:4.3: ‘āsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:4.4: anāsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:4.5: āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:4.6: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya.
segments.mn126:4.7: Āsañcepi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, bhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:4.8: anāsañcepi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, bhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:4.9: āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, bhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:4.10: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, bhabbā phalassa adhigamāyā’ti.
segments.mn126:4.11: Na kho me taṃ, rājakumāra, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ.
segments.mn126:4.12: Ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyyā”ti.
segments.mn126:5.1: “Sace kho bhoto bhūmijassa satthā evaṃvādī [evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] evamakkhāyī, addhā bhoto bhūmijassa satthā sabbesaṃyeva puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ muddhānaṃ [buddhānaṃ (ka.) muddhānantimuddhaṃ, matthakanti attho] maññe āhacca tiṭṭhatī”ti.
segments.mn126:6.1: Atha kho jayaseno rājakumāro āyasmantaṃ bhūmijaṃ sakeneva thālipākena parivisi.
segments.mn126:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā bhūmijo pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bhūmijo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn126:7.2: “idhāhaṃ, bhante, pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena jayasenassa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃ.
segments.mn126:7.3: Atha kho, bhante, jayaseno rājakumāro yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā mayā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn126:7.4: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho, bhante, jayaseno rājakumāro maṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn126:7.5: ‘santi, bho bhūmija, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino – āsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:7.7: anāsañcepi karitvā … pe … āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:7.9: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāyā’ti.
segments.mn126:7.11: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, jayasenaṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn126:7.12: ‘na kho me taṃ, rājakumāra, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ.
segments.mn126:7.13: Ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyya – āsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:7.15: anāsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:7.16: āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:7.17: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya.
segments.mn126:7.18: Āsañcepi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, bhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:7.19: anāsañcepi karitvā … pe … āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā … pe … nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ caranti, bhabbā phalassa adhigamāyāti.
segments.mn126:7.22: Na kho me taṃ, rājakumāra, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ.
segments.mn126:7.23: Ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyyā’ti.
segments.mn126:7.24: ‘Sace bhoto bhūmijassa satthā evaṃvādī evamakkhāyī, addhā bhoto bhūmijassa satthā sabbesaṃyeva puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ muddhānaṃ maññe āhacca tiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.mn126:7.25: ‘Kaccāhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī’”ti?
segments.mn126:8.1: “Taggha tvaṃ, bhūmija, evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me hosi, na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarosi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
segments.mn126:9.1: Ye hi keci, bhūmija, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā micchādiṭṭhino micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākammantā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhino te āsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:9.2: anāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:9.3: āsañca anāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
segments.mn126:9.4: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya.
segments.mn126:10.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhūmija, puriso telatthiko telagavesī telapariyesanaṃ caramāno vālikaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya.

segments.mn126:10.5: nevāsaṃ nānāsañcepi karitvā vālikaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya, abhabbo telassa adhigamāya.

segments.mn126:19.1: “Sace kho taṃ, bhūmija, jayasenassa rājakumārassa imā catasso upamā paṭibhāyeyyuṃ anacchariyaṃ te jayaseno rājakumāro pasīdeyya, pasanno ca te pasannākāraṃ kareyyā”ti.
segments.mn126:19.2: “Kuto pana maṃ, bhante, jayasenassa rājakumārassa imā catasso upamā paṭibhāyissanti anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā, seyyathāpi bhagavantan”ti?
segments.mn126:19.4: Attamano āyasmā bhūmijo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Sakena thālipākenāti pakatipavattāya bhikkhāya attano niṭṭhitabhattatopi bhattena parivisi.

Āsañcepi karitvāti,“imināhaṃ brahmacariyena devo vā bhaveyyaṃ devaññataro vā, dukkhato vā mucceyyan”ti patthanaṃ katvā cepi caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya taṇhāya brahmacariyassa vidūsitattāti adhippāyo.
Paṇidhānavasena hi puññaphalaṃ niyataṃ nāma hoti, tadabhāvato kataṃ puññaṃ na labhatīti adhippāyo.

Tatiyapakkhe ubhayaṭṭhānehi vuttaṃ, catutthapakkho sammāvatāro iti catukoṭiko pañho jālavasena āhaṭo, tattha āsā nāma patthanā, micchāgāhasmiṃ sati na vipaccati, sammāgāhasmiṃ sati vipaccati, ubhayathāpi ubhayāpekkhānāma, yo micchattadhamme purakkhatvā brahmacariyaṃ carati, tassa yathādhippāyaphalaṃ samijjhatīti na vattabbaṃ ayoniso brahmacariyassa ciṇṇattā;
yo pana sammattaṃ purakkhatvā brahmacariyaṃ carati, tassa yathādhippāyaṃ brahmacariyaphalaṃ na samijjhatīti na vattabbaṃ yoniso brahmacariyassa ciṇṇattā.
Esa nayo sabbatthāti,“majjhimo, daharo”ti āgatesu upamāvāresu,“thero”tiādinā āgatesu upameyyavāresūti pañcasu saṃkilesapakkhiyesu vāresu esa yathāvuttova nayoti veditabbo.
